memories.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled by CI because the release job's cargo registry cache is never persisted between runs, so every release build starts cold; the ~18 minute cold-cache penalty plus normal build time pushes total runtime past the 30-minute CI timeout, causing cancellation. Fix: add cache save/restore keyed on Cargo.lock to the release build job specifically (other CI jobs already do this; the release pipeline was never wired up the same way) — do not just raise the timeout, as that masks the problem and slows every release.
